records.DESCRIPTION: LR - Port side chain cable stud to be repaired.

CR - The weld beads of the studs on the first three shots of the port-side anchor chain were found to be defective.
It is recommended that the above-mentioned deficiency to be dealt with as soon as possible but not later than 09 December 2026.

CR - The bow echo sounder was out of order and the stern echo sounder was found normal condition.
It is recommended that the above-mentioned deficiency to be dealt with as soon as possible but not later than
21 Jan. 2027.(refer to Job No.E26224)
The administration and this society shall be informed immediately if the stern echo sounder is out of order.
